name: Tooly
character: a small open-ended spanner standing upright as a creature: the handle is its compact body with short stubby arms and legs, and the open C-shaped jaw at the top forms two rounded prongs above its oversized head like a pair of ears, with a hi-vis orange grip band around its middle
colour: bright cobalt blue body like #2E52B8, hi-vis safety orange grip band
feature: the open spanner jaw on top of its head, like two rounded ears
personality: capable, quick, plain-spoken; a workshop hand who gets on with it
represents: Tolra's built-in AI helper: ask in plain words, and the job gets sorted
role: A spanner you can talk to: ask Tooly, and the job gets sorted.

concepts.character: a small open-ended spanner standing upright as a creature: the handle is its compact body with short stubby arms and legs, and the open C-shaped jaw at the top forms two rounded prongs above its oversized head like a pair of ears, with a hi-vis orange grip band around its middle

concepts.character: a chunky adjustable spanner creature, wide and sturdy: a big square-jawed head with one fixed jaw and one sliding jaw forming a broad grin-shaped profile, a round knurled thumbwheel on its cheek, a short thick handle body with stubby arms and legs
concepts.colour: bright cobalt blue body like #2E52B8, hi-vis safety orange thumbwheel
concepts.feature: the orange knurled thumbwheel on its cheek
concepts.role: An adjustable spanner that fits whatever you ask: Tolra's helper, sized to the job.

concepts.character: a ring spanner creature with a big round ring-shaped head: the face sits on a solid disc inside a thick ring with twelve tiny notches around its inner edge, on a short tapering handle body with stubby arms and legs and a small hexagonal nut held in one hand
concepts.colour: bright cobalt blue body like #2E52B8, hi-vis safety orange hexagonal nut
concepts.feature: the thick notched ring around its round face
concepts.role: A ring spanner that never slips: ask Tooly, and nothing gets missed.

lines.hello: Ask me anything about your jobs, quotes or invoices.
lines.empty: Ask a question and I'll get to work.
lines.oops: I couldn't finish that. Nothing was changed.
lines.tip: Try: which jobs are late this week?
lines.love: Tell me, so I get better at your workshop.
lines.bannerBody: An admin can turn the helper on.
